mapper.select: SELECT payload_bytes FROM catalog_outbox WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND outbox_id=#{id} AND purpose='COORDINATOR' AND record_kind='FRAGMENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_outbox SET state='PUBLISHED',broker_partition=#{partition},broker_offset=#{offset},published_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND outbox_id=#{id} AND purpose='KAFKA' AND state='PAUSED' AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until IS NULL
